title: MClans
description: MClans is a simple and user-friendly clan plugin for Paper/Spigot servers. The plugin adds a clan system with commands for players and administrators, colored PlaceholderAPI placeholders, and an intuitive GUI.
body:
MClans is a simple and user-friendly clan plugin for Paper/Spigot servers. The plugin adds a clan system with commands for players and administrators, colored PlaceholderAPI placeholders, and an intuitive GUI.

Features /clan command for players /aklan command for admins Player GUI Admin GUI Creating clans Inviting players to a clan Accepting invitations Leaving a clan Kicking players from a clan Deleting clans Saving data to clans. yml integration with PlaceholderAPI colored clan placeholder: green when the player is in a clan, red when the player is not in a clan Placeholders The plugin supports PlaceholderAPI.

Available placeholders:

%mclans_clan%

returns the clan name in green if the player is in a clan; returns “NO CLAN” in red if the player is not in a clan %mclans_clan_raw%

returns the raw clan name without colors; if the player is not in a clan, returns “NO CLAN” Commands Player /clan

opens the clan GUI /clan create <name>

creates a clan /clan invite <player>

invites a player to the clan /clan accept <clan>

accepts a clan invitation /clan leave

leaves the clan /clan kick <player>

kicks a player from the clan /clan disband

dissolves the clan /clan info [clan]

displays information about the clan Admin /aklan

opens the administration GUI /aklan reload

reloads the configuration and data /aklan delete <clan>

deletes the selected clan /aklan set <player> <clan>




-----------------------------------------------------------------


MClans to prosty i wygodny plugin na klany dla serwerów Paper/Spigot.
Plugin dodaje system klanów z komendami dla graczy i administracji, kolorowane placeholdery PlaceholderAPI oraz czytelne GUI.

Funkcje
komenda /klan dla graczy
komenda /aklan dla administracji
GUI dla gracza
GUI dla admina
tworzenie klanów
zapraszanie graczy do klanu
akceptowanie zaproszeń
opuszczanie klanu
wyrzucanie graczy z klanu
usuwanie klanów
zapis danych do clans.yml
integracja z PlaceholderAPI
kolorowany placeholder klanu:
zielony, gdy gracz jest w klanie
czerwony, gdy gracz nie jest w klanie
Placeholdery
Plugin obsługuje PlaceholderAPI.

Dostępne placeholdery:

%mclans_clan%

zwraca zieloną nazwę klanu, jeśli gracz jest w klanie
zwraca czerwone BRAK KLANU, jeśli gracz nie jest w klanie
%mclans_clan_raw%

zwraca surową nazwę klanu bez kolorów
jeśli gracz nie jest w klanie, zwraca BRAK KLANU
